newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Australian dlr, bonds steady on May trade surplus.
newsitem.headline: Australian dlr, bonds steady on May trade surplus.

text.p: The Australian dollar and bonds were steady after the release of an A$873 million surplus in the balance of goods and services for May.
The trade figure compared with a median market forecast of a A$163 million surplus, and forecasts ranged from a A$400 million deficit to a A$500 million surplus.
The Australian dollar was trading at US$0.7524/29 from a level of US$0.7523/28 shortly before the data was released.
September 10-year bond futures eased a notch to 92.920 from a pre-data level of 92.930.
